analysis: All three units cover a single documentation-only change to docs/architecture/inference.md. Units 4 and 5 show base text (lines 829-1195, MiMo native lifecycle, Flash-Next, Invariants, Code map). Unit 6 shows head text lines 1-405 only, with the "Last updated: 2026-10-19" header. No patch hunks and no source or code files were supplied, so I could not diff base against head or see the rest of the head file. The visible head portion describes calibration, deadlines, measurements and the request path. These read as documentation of existing behavior, with no visible new endpoints, keys, or authorization or encryption changes. Docs state that calibration is local-only and excluded from rate training, that deadline profiles are empty, and that prefix cache scope is coordinator-authored. This is consistent with T-041/SEC-035, T-010 and the TB-002/TB-007 boundaries. No threat-model assumption (A-001, A-003, TB-002, TB-007) appears invalidated by what is visible. Coverage limit: the head text for lines 405 onward, including the code map, invariants and prefix-cache statements that might differ, was not supplied, so a full base-versus-head comparison is impossible. Docs-only changes carry no runtime security effect. The next pass should confirm that no code files were changed in the PR and that the docs do not overstate controls, for example around the TTL or the encrypted SSD cache.
